Method of Attack: Distributing malware via fake security certificate update requests displayed on compromised websites
Using a malicious installer disguised as a security certificate update
Downloading and installing malware including backdoors and Trojans
Buerak Trojan downloader downloads and installs additional malware
Mokes backdoor steals user credentials, captures keystrokes, records ambient audio every 5 minutes, takes screenshots, and intercepts browser input
Impacted Systems: Users of compromised websites including auto part stores and a zoo website
Attack Vector: Malicious iframe overlay on compromised websites showing fake NET::ERR_CERT_OUT_OF_DATE error
User interaction by clicking 'Install (Recommended)' button to download malware
Indicators of Compromise: URL ldfidfa[.]pw loading malicious iframe content from https://ldfidfa[.]pw//chrome.html
Injected jquery.js script overlaying malicious iframe
